$comment: Provider registers this Offer in PNP - Phase 1 (Policy Negotiation). Unlike vet-cert-offer-001 (UC6), this Offer is for low-sensitivity public health advisory data and is configured with a fast-track Negotiator that returns directAgreement: true, permitting the DSP 2025-1 direct REQUESTED -> AGREED transition (skipping OFFERED/ACCEPTED) for any verified Polish organization. The assignee PartyCollection has no `source` (member ids resolved from an external source at decision time is not supported by DefaultPolicyArbiter - see docs/architecture/components.md's Party Scoping note); it is matched entirely by evaluating its `refinement` against the request data. Both refinements use the canonical `$`-prefixed twin:jsonPath expression form, and the AssetCollection target carries the `source`/expression pair DefaultPolicyArbiter requires to resolve it - this example is executable as written against the current arbiter, not just illustrative.

negotiationConfig.$comment: Provider-side configuration only, not part of the ODRL policy itself - shown here to make explicit which Negotiator handles this Offer's negotiations
